name: Coleslaw
description: This is a coleslaw recipe that I got from a chili restaurant in my neighborhood that closed down a few years ago. This recipe makes more dressing than needed for the coleslaw, so you can save it or use it as a vegetable dip.

ingredients.name: Head of green cabbage
ingredients.originalText: One large head of green cabbage

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 3/4 cup mayonnaise; 1/2 cup buttermilk; 3 tbsp lemon juice; 3 tbsp apple cider vinegar; 4 tbsp distilled vinegar; 1/3 cup olive oil; 1/4 cup granulated sugar; 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt; 1 tsp ground black pepper; 1 tsp celery seeds; 1/2 tsp onion powder; 1/4 tsp granulated garlic; 1/4 tsp mustard powder; One large head of green cabbage; One large carrot. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Finely shred, rinse, and drain the carrot
Finely shred the cabbage (use a food processor if possible)
Whisk together the mayonnaise, buttermilk, lemon juice, cider vinegar, distilled vinegar, olive oil, and sugar
Add the salt, pepper, celery seeds, onion powder, and granulated garlic, and combine well
Combine the shredded cabbage and carrot in a separate bowl
Slowly add the dressing until it lightly coats the vegetables, and toss well.
Add more dressing until it tastes good
Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Declan Cash
source.originalInstructions:
1. Finely shred, rinse, and drain the carrot
2. Finely shred the cabbage (use a food processor if possible)
3. Whisk together the mayonnaise, buttermilk, lemon juice, cider vinegar, distilled vinegar, olive oil, and sugar
4. Add the salt, pepper, celery seeds, onion powder, and granulated garlic, and combine well
5. Combine the shredded cabbage and carrot in a separate bowl
6. Slowly add the dressing until it lightly coats the vegetables, and toss well. Add more dressing until it tastes good
7. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving
